name: Lint CSS Token Usage
description: When a CSS file is saved, verify that no literal hex colors are used in redesigned component stylesheets — only --cs-* design tokens are allowed.

actions.prompt: The file {{filePath}} was just saved. Check if this file contains any literal hex color values (#rrggbb or #rgb), rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), or hsla() color literals in rule declarations (not inside CSS custom property definitions in :root). The keywords transparent, currentColor, inherit, none are exempt. If violations are found, list them with line numbers and suggest using the appropriate --cs-* design token instead. Also verify that every backdrop-filter declaration has a matching -webkit-backdrop-filter in the same rule block.
